mcq.q: Web routes Laravel 11, 12 aur 13 mein kis file mein likhte hain?
mcq.why: Browser wale routes `routes/web.php` mein hote hain.

mcq.q: Kisi resource ko delete karne ke liye kaunsa route method use hota hai?

mcq.why: Yeh sab registered routes, unke methods aur names dikhata hai.

mcq.q: Naye Laravel 11+ project mein `routes/api.php` ke liye kya karna padta hai?
options: Kuch nahi, pehle se hota hai
mcq.why: Slim skeleton mein api.php default nahi hota. `php artisan install:api` use karo.

mcq.q: Named route `products.show` ka URL kaise banate hain?
mcq.why: `route()` helper naam se URL generate karta hai.

mcq.q: Optional route parameter kaise likhte hain?
mcq.why: Naam ke baad `?` lagao aur function mein default value do.

mcq.q: HTML form se PUT request bhejne ke liye Blade mein kya likhte hain?
mcq.why: Browser form sirf GET/POST bhejta hai, isliye `@method('PUT')` spoof karta hai.

mcq.q: POST form mein `@csrf` na ho to kya hoga?
mcq.why: CSRF token missing hone par Laravel 419 deta hai.

assignments.title: Basic website routes
assignments.brief: Ek chhoti website ke liye saare basic routes banao.
assignments.explain: Closure routes chhote kaam ke liye theek hain. POST route ko real form se test karne ke liye `@csrf` lagana padega.

solution.code:
<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

Route::get('/', fn () => 'Welcome');
Route::get('/about', fn () => 'About us');
Route::get('/contact', fn () => 'Contact form');
Route::post('/contact', fn () => 'Message received');

assignments.title: Products with controller
assignments.brief: Products ke liye controller aur named routes banao.
tasks: `show` route par sirf numeric id allow karo

solution.code:
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

class ProductController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        return 'Product List';
    }

    public function show(string $id)
    {
        return "Product #{$id}";
    }
}

Id na ho to 'Saare orders' return karo
assignments.explain: Optional parameter ke saath function mein default value (`null`) dena zaroori hai.

interview.a: URL aur HTTP method ko closure ya controller action se map karna. Web routes `routes/web.php` mein hote hain.
GET data padhne ke liye hai. POST data bhejne ke liye hai aur Laravel mein CSRF token chahiye.
Route ko `->name()` se naam dena, taaki `route('naam')` se URL ban jaye aur URL badalne par code na badalna pade.

interview.q: Closure route aur controller route mein kya farak hai?
interview.a: Closure chhote kaam ke liye hai. Controller code ko organized rakhta hai. Route caching ke liye closure routes ko controller mein badalna padta hai.

interview.q: PUT aur PATCH mein kya farak hai?
interview.a: PUT poore resource ko replace karta hai, PATCH sirf kuch fields update karta hai.

interview.q: Route parameter aur query string mein farak?
interview.a: Route parameter URL path ka hissa hai (`/users/5`), query string `?page=2` jaisa hota hai aur `request()->query()` se milta hai.
Jab koi bhi route match na kare, tab custom 404 jaisa response dene ke liye.

interview.q: 419 Page Expired error kyun aata hai?
interview.a: Aksar POST/PUT/DELETE form mein CSRF token missing ya expire hone par.
